title: Report: GTA 6 Weather Bug Fix: How to Make It Rain on PS5
description: RockstarINTEL reports a player-discovered PS5 workaround for the GTA 6 weather bug after Rockstar's recent patch. The method is attributed to the publication and Twitter user @Fallneck_Talnek, not confirmed by Rockstar Games.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Weather Bug Fix: Make It Rain on PS5
socialHook: RockstarINTEL reports a PS5 workaround to fix the GTA 6 weather bug and restore rain.

sections.heading: Reported GTA 6 Weather Bug Workaround
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reports that Grand Theft Auto VI players on PS5 have criticized the lack of changing weather, including rain and hurricanes. The publication says Rockstar Games released a patch earlier this week to address weather not changing for extended periods, but many players still see little difference. RockstarINTEL attributes a self-applied fix to a Twitter user named @Fallneck_Talnek and states that many people report it worked well for them.

sections.heading: Source Attribution and Unknowns
paragraphs: The workaround is presented by RockstarINTEL as a player discovery, not an official Rockstar Games announcement. The publication notes the fix applies only to PS5 and says it will cover an Xbox Series X|S solution if one appears. Whether Rockstar intends to endorse the method, how long it remains effective, and whether it works on other platforms remain unknown based on the available report.
